name: Trainer Lens
description: Information panels for FireRed and LeafGreen: area Pokemon, party, opponent and your Pokemon sheets (IVs, EVs, stats chart), moves, item radar, one-click field tools with Auto Repel, trainer card, progress, area and region maps, Pokedex, bag, Day-Care, encounter counter, notices and a PC viewer with moving, box locks and sorting. Docks in Trainer Desk, or opens up to five desktop windows. English, Spanish, Portuguese and Japanese.
